rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Fitch affirmed BBB+ and revised outlook to Positive from Stable, citing improving profitability and balance sheet trajectory. Path to A- upgrade dependent on sustained cash-to-debt improvement to ~120% by 2019.
Best financial year ever in 2018; sustained improvement in cash-to-debt and operating margins triggered upgrade. CTHS executed on Fitch's stated upgrade path.

outcome_class_rationale: Two-notch positive trajectory: Stable outlook -> Positive outlook (mid-2017) -> A- upgrade (2018). Strong operating performance drove rating improvement.
